title: Mole Madness
description: Fast-reflex arcade whacker with a 60-second countdown. Whack golden moles for time bonuses, trigger freeze storms, dodge volatile TNT bombs, and rack up x5 combo multipliers!
author: AwaisGames Studio

controls.desktop: Click holes or use Keys: Q W E / A S D / Z X C / 1 2 3 · P: Pause
